verdict.rationale: Lago ships a Dunning Agent that autonomously reviews each customer's payment history and chases overdue invoices before handing off to a person. Invoices are also generated automatically per plan model, so some autonomous background work is clearly evidenced. However, the evidence shows only these prebuilt, domain-specific automations, not a way for users to define their own background automations; the plain-language AI agent is described as interactive management rather than scheduled autonomous runs. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation/workflow builder, scheduling or trigger configuration for custom agent tasks, detailed docs on the Dunning Agent's autonomy controls, independent hands-on corroboration.
